name: code-review
description: Deep-review a GitHub pull request one file at a time. Fetches the diff with your local `gh`, weights every changed file by blast radius (churn, path criticality, fan-in inside the changed set, add/delete/rename), then reviews each file in isolation — heaviest first, each review seeing only its own diff. Findings are appended to a JSONL log on your machine; nothing is ever posted back to the PR.
author: PersonalClaw
